title: Left step in merging
statement: Let $l$ and $r$ be lists of integers and let $i,j$ be natural numbers with $i<|l|$ and $j<|r|$. If the $i$th entry of $l$ is at most the $j$th entry of $r$, then merging the tails of $l$ and $r$ beginning at those indices gives the $i$th entry of $l$ followed by the merge of the tail of $l$ after that entry with the unchanged tail of $r$ beginning at $j$.
